<issue>
Feature request: support tag filtering for backup-vault
Cloud-nuke should support filtering for tags in the AWS backup-vault resource.

<sup>Thomas Gunsch thomas.gunsch@mercedes-benz.com, Mercedes-Benz AG on behalf of Mercedes-Benz Tech Innovation GmbH, [Provider Information](https://github.com/mercedes-benz/foss/blob/main/PROVIDER_INFORMATION.md)</sup>

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (cloud-nuke, Go), show the full contents of aws/resources/backup_vault*.go (non-test) and also how another resource (e.g. one that supports tag filtering via config.ShouldInclude with Tags field, like ec2 or kms/ecr) does it: show the config.ResourceValue / ShouldInclude signature and tag-filter usage example. Also show the docs mention of backup-vault in README.md tag-support table.

The tag-support table is in docs/supported-resources.md.","findings":["aws/resources/backup_vault.go: BackupVaultAPI has 4 methods: DeleteBackupVault, DeleteRecoveryPoint, ListBackupVaults, ListRecoveryPointsByBackupVault. NewBackupVault() uses resource.Resource[BackupVaultAPI] with ResourceTypeName 'backup-vault', BatchSize DefaultBatchSize, and ConfigGetter returning c.BackupVault. Lister is listBackupVaults. Nuker is resource.MultiStepDeleter(nukeRecoveryPoints, nukeBackupVault).","backup_vault.go, listBackupVaults: it paginates ListBackupVaults and calls cfg.ShouldInclude(config.ResourceValue{Name: backupVault.BackupVaultName, Time: backupVault.CreationDate}). There is no Tags field, so tag filtering is unsupported. It returns []*string of vault names.","nukeRecoveryPoints lists and deletes every recovery point, then calls waitUntilRecoveryPointsDeleted. That polls every 1s with a 1-minute timeout, using ListRecoveryPointsByBackupVault with MaxResults=1. nukeBackupVault then calls DeleteBackupVault.","config/config.go:553: type ResourceValue struct { Name *string; Time *time.Time; Tags map[string]string }.","config/config.go:645: func (r ResourceType) ShouldInclude(value ResourceValue) bool. It checks the name regex via ShouldInclude(name, includeREs, excludeREs), then ShouldIncludeBasedOnTime when Time is non-nil, then ShouldIncludeBasedOnTag(value.Tags). The package-level ShouldInclude is at config.go:532.","config/config.go:406: FilterRule has NamesRegExp, TimeAfter, TimeBefore, Tags map[string]Expression, and TagsOperator ('AND' or 'OR', default OR).","Tag-filter example at aws/resources/ami.go:63-67: cfg.ShouldInclude(config.ResourceValue{Name: image.Name, Time: createdTime, Tags: util.ConvertTypesTagsToMap(image.Tags)}).
